kind: review specification, NOT an importable GTM export
fixtureRule: Never import the local fixture sink into GTM; reject mgi_test=true and mgi_transport=fixture in any future production trigger
consentRule: Keep existing policy and personalized-ad denial; verify actual Ads consent requirements before enabling lead events. Do not change consent defaults in this package.
triggerRule: Exact event plus exact new hostname plus verified live receipt plus test=false; no All Forms, page views, thank-you paths, clicks, or widget open triggers
googleLoaderRule: Use the new container's existing Google tag; no legacy container or additional standalone loader
callRule: ST DNI remains number owner. Completed call is the vendor import; phone tap is not a conversion. Do not install Google WCM replacement.
dedupRule: One acquisition receipt, one chosen primary action. If the same signal is sent through native import and browser tag, select one path before enabling; a transaction ID is not cross-action deduplication.
activationGates: exact action ID and label from Ads
